description: Drag a source to a target, coordinate, or relative offset. Use toOffset when the target's drop subregion affects the result.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the drag source and destination.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the drag source.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID for the drag source.

toSelector.description: CSS selector for the destination. Without toOffset, the drop point defaults to the destination center.

toId.description: Canonical destination ID. Without toOffset, the drop point defaults to the destination center.

toOffset.description: Normalized point inside the destination (0–1). Use y=0.2/0.8 when upper/lower drop zones change the result.

dx.description: Relative horizontal drag offset when not using an explicit destination.

dy.description: Relative vertical drag offset when not using an explicit destination.

purpose.description: Describe the drag effect, such as moving a slider, reordering an item, or dropping onto a target.

purposeHint: Describe the drag effect, such as moving a slider, reordering an item, or dropping onto a target.
